subject: BrightCart x Redwood — Marketplace private offer & unit-price mapping (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightCart x Redwood — Marketplace private offer & unit-price mapping (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks Samir — really great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Recap of what we covered:
- BrightCart current usage profile: ~250M inference tokens/month now, spiking to ~1.2B in Q4 (you mentioned holiday surge).
- Primary workloads: product-description generation (batch), real-time chat assistance (low-latency), and nightly embedding indexing.
- Procurement: evaluating AWS Marketplace private offer to streamline procurement and billing.

2) Pricing qualification items we need from you (can reply inline):
- Confirm typical monthly token volume (avg + peak). You said ~250M now / ~1.2B peak — please confirm ranges by workload.
- Target cost goal: you mentioned aiming for roughly $X per 1M tokens as a procurement target. Can you share a target $/1M tokens or a budget range for the contract year?
- Marketplace constraints: do you need unit price to map to a single line item (per-1M tokens) in the private offer? Any procurement/legal constraints we should be aware of?

3) Redwood next steps (what we can do immediately):
- I attached a quick usage snapshot template for your team to populate (BrightCart-usage-snapshot.csv).
- Aditya and I will draft an initial unit-price mapping for an AWS private offer (baseline + tiered volume discounts) and share a PDF for your procurement team to review.
- If useful, we can loop in Elena (AWS marketplace rep) to confirm mapping/contract flow.

Proposed timeline: if you can send the populated usage snapshot by next Tue (7/20), we’ll have a draft private-offer mapping and price ladder to share by the following Thu (7/22).

Thanks again — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightCart x Redwood — Marketplace private offer & unit-price mapping (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers inline below: 

On Wed, Jul 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Confirm typical monthly token volume (avg + peak). You said ~250M now / ~1.2B peak — please confirm ranges by workload.

Current confirmed ranges (estimates, happy to provide logs):
- Product descriptions (batch): 120M tokens/month (stable)
- Real-time chat (support/assistant): 80M tokens/month (avg), peaks up to 350M tokens/day during incidents
- Embeddings/indexing (nightly): 50M tokens/month (but expected to grow when we expand catalog)
- Total current average: ~250M/month, expected Q4 peak cumulative ~1.2B/month

> - Target cost goal: you mentioned aiming for roughly $X per 1M tokens as a procurement target.

Procurement target: our finance team is aiming for a target blended rate of $700–$900 per 1M tokens across workloads for the first-year committed volume. If we can get predictable unit pricing mapped in Marketplace that would be ideal.

> - Marketplace constraints: do you need unit price to map to a single line item (per-1M tokens) in the private offer? Any procurement/legal constraints we should be aware of?

Procurement constraints: yes — for internal billing clarity we'd prefer a single "Tokens (1M units)" line item on the invoice with a unit price, plus an optional tiered discount schedule. Also need standard PO & SSA timelines (procurement wants contracts signed by end of Aug).

I’ve attached a procurement timeline template we use internally (procurement-timeline-template.xlsx). Happy to hop on a short call with procurement + Aditya if needed.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightCart
samir@brightcart.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightCart x Redwood — Marketplace private offer & unit-price mapping (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks Samir — helpful detail and the $700–$900/1M tokens target gives us a clear budget band to work in. A few notes from our side after reviewing your usage ranges: 

- Baseline mapping proposal (draft):
  * Line item: "Inference tokens (per 1M tokens)"
  * Baseline unit price: $1,000 per 1M tokens (public list), with private-offer baseline options in the $750–$900 range depending on annual commit / term length.
  * Tiering suggestion: 0–500M: $900/1M; 500M–2B: $750/1M; 2B+: $600/1M (these are draft and negotiable).

- Marketplace mechanics: AWS private offers allow mapping a SKU/unit price. We typically map a 1M-token SKU and apply quantized quantities so procurement sees a per-1M token unit price on the invoice. Elena — can you confirm any technical limits on SKU granularity?

- Deal structuring: If BrightCart is willing to commit to a 12-month committed spend (e.g., 9–12M 1M-token units over the year), we can move pricing toward the $700/1M band. We’ll model projections once we receive the usage CSV.

I attached a draft mapping PDF (Redwood-AWS-Marketplace-PO-mapping-v1.pdf) that shows how we’d present the SKU and tier bands for procurement review.

Next: Samir — once you return the usage snapshot, we’ll produce a final private-offer mapping and provide a short procurement one-pager your legal team can use.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0177

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick confirmation of actions and timeline: 

- Samir: please return the populated BrightCart-usage-snapshot.csv and the procurement timeline template by Tue 2026-07-20.
- Aditya: finalize the mapping based on the ranges Samir provided and refine the tiering to show a 12-month commit option hitting $700/1M.

I’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement sync for Thu 2026-07-22 (invite to follow) to walk the procurement/legal team through the private-offer flow and the draft mapping. If any of the dates are tight for your teams, flag now and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement.

Best,
Marissa
